title: D2 OTel messaging activity tags spec
description: Schema for contracts/otel-messaging-tags/otel-messaging-tags.spec.json — the source-of-truth catalog of OTel semantic-convention attribute names (and a small set of D2-specific d2.* attributes) emitted on RabbitMQ publisher + consumer spans. D2.Shared.OtelMessagingTags.SourceGen reads it to emit MessagingActivityTags into D2.Shared.Messaging.RabbitMq; tools/ts-codegen/src/otel-messaging-tags-emit.ts reads it to emit otel-messaging-tags.g.ts into @d2/telemetry. Spec-driving the catalog structurally prevents the kind of drift bug where the consumer side wrote 'messaging.operation' while the publisher correctly wrote 'messaging.operation.type'.

tags.description: Closed catalog of OTel messaging activity-tag entries.

constName.description: Public C# / TS constant identifier — UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Must be unique across the spec.

value.description: Wire-format OTel attribute name emitted on the Activity. Must be unique across the spec.

doc.description: XML <summary> / JSDoc text rendered on the emitted constant.
